messages:
Marta: Quick UI QA — noticed the floating action button is overlapping toasts on the dashboard grid when there are 2+ quick notifications. Screenshot attached. Can we tighten spacing or change toast anchor?
Liam: I saw that too. Happens when grid has compact row spacing + toasts are bottom-right anchored. FAB z-index is higher so it sits on top.
Devin: Is this a token problem or layout priority? We intentionally reduced row spacing to 8px for density.
Marta: I think it's both. The toasts are using spacing token `space-xs` (8) and the FAB has a 16px margin from edge. When screen height is small they overlap.
Claire: Two options: 1) Increase bottom toast offset to account for FAB, 2) Pin toasts to bottom-left for dashboards, 3) Reduce FAB hit-area but keep visual size (a11y risk).
Marta: Prefer 1 or 2. Left-side toasts might interfere with list actions. 1 feels safer.
Liam: Agreed. We could add a toast offset token like `toast-offset-bottom` that composes with `fab-edge-gap`. Then teams can opt-in by layout.
Devin: Proposal: default `toast-offset-bottom: 24px` when `fab-present=true`. Current default is 16px. That covers most small screens. Anyone worried about motion or visual overlap during entrance?
Claire: Make sure entering animation respects reduced offset so they don't animate under the FAB. Also check `role=alert`/aria-live priority — we can't hide toasts to screen readers even if visually offset.
Marta: Good call. Accessibility: add `aria-label` content check. Some toasts were just icons and no text for screen readers.
design-bot: Suggested token diffs:
```
- spacing: { space-xs: 8, space-sm: 12 }
+ tokens: {
+   toast-offset-bottom: 24, // default when FAB present
+   fab-edge-gap: 16
+ }
```
Liam: I like an opt-in data-attribute: `<body data-fab='true'>` so the toast system can compute offset at runtime rather than hardcoding per page.
Devin: Runtime is fine but we should provide a CSS var fallback: `--toast-offset-bottom: var(--fab-edge-gap, 16px)` and allow override.
Claire: Copy nit: update toast docs to recommend brief prefix text for screen readers e.g., `aria-label="Success: saved autosave"` instead of only an icon.
Marta: I'll make a small PR with token bump + demo page showing before/after. Can someone review accessibility examples?
Liam: I'll review the PR. Quick checklist: visual overlap fixed on small heights, animation doesn't clip, focus stays sane, and SR reads full message.
Devin: Also run console layout regression — compact grid shouldn't reflow when toast is taller. Add test case.
Marta: Thanks — will push in next hour. :thumbsup:
